CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

   D. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   B. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)

   D. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)

14. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)

   C. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
